params.name: Cluster Count
params.tooltip:
How many separate groups of towns to form.

Towns are generated normally and then rearranged into these groups.

params.name: Cluster Sizes
params.tooltip:
How much the clusters differ in size.

Equal gives every cluster the same number of towns. The others let one conurbation dominate, with the rest trailing off - Lopsided most sharply. The exact shape is drawn per map, so the same setting looks different on a different seed.

params.name: Towns Left In Place
params.tooltip:
What share of the generated towns keep the position the map generator gave them.

The rest are moved next to a cluster. The total number of towns never changes, so there is no need to adjust the game's Town Density.

params.name: Isolated Towns
params.tooltip:
What share of the moved towns stay out in the country instead of joining a cluster.

Isolated towns are scaled down, so they read as outlying hamlets.
